defaults.unsubscribeText: You’re receiving this because we believed this professional-partnership message may be relevant to your business.

messages.title: A professional tanning partnership for {{business_name}}
messages.preview: A short note about a professional trial for West Coast salons — reply or request information.
messages.headline: Natural-looking color, made for West Coast light.

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},

I’m reaching out because {{business_name}} looks like the kind of {{business_type}} we’d like to partner with on the West Coast — premium service, strong presentation, and clients who care about how their color looks well beyond the treatment room.

Sunless by Jimmy Coco is the professional tanning line created by celebrity tanning artist Jimmy Coco. His method is built around believable, undertone-aware color — the kind that reads natural in daylight, photography, and evening light rather than turning flat or orange.
We’re starting conversations with a small number of California, Oregon, and Washington salons about the professional solution and a carefully edited take-home range.
Would a professional trial or a short introduction call be useful for {{business_name}} in {{city}}?
Or simply reply to this email and I’ll keep it straightforward.

messages.title: Color that still looks right in West Coast light
messages.preview: Undertone-aware color, built to stay believable in daylight, photos, and evening light.
messages.eyebrow: The result beyond the treatment room
messages.headline: Color your clients trust in daylight.

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},

The real test of a professional tan isn’t how it looks under treatment-room lighting. It’s how it reads afterward — in strong {{state}} daylight, in photographs, at weddings and events, and while traveling.
That’s the thinking behind Jimmy Coco’s shade method. The goal isn’t simply “darker.” It’s controlled depth, undertone awareness, and a finish that looks considered rather than obvious.

items: A more confident consultation with each client
A result clients can wear to high-visibility occasions
A premium service story that doesn’t depend on discounting
A recognizable, expert-led name behind the treatment

blocks.html: If it’s helpful, I can share the professional shade guide so you can see how the method approaches undertone and depth.
Prefer product details first? Reply and I’ll send professional information for {{state}}.

messages.title: One client relationship, two revenue lines
messages.preview: A premium service plus a focused take-home range — without leaning on discounting.
messages.headline: One client relationship, two revenue lines.

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},
The strongest salon partnerships do more than place a product in the treatment room. They create one coherent client journey — with two natural commercial moments.

In the booth, the professional solution supports a premium service built on shade selection, controlled depth, and believable color. After the appointment, a focused take-home edit lets clients maintain or extend the result.
That’s treatment revenue and relevant retail from the same client relationship — without relying on discounting, and without turning your front desk into an overstocked retail wall.
The exact West Coast range, terms, and availability are confirmed through the approved trade route. I won’t quote anything I can’t stand behind.
Or reply and tell me how retail fits into your service today.

messages.title: A trial-first way to begin with Sunless
messages.preview: Professional guidance, team education, and West Coast trade details shared once approved.
messages.headline: A trial-first way to begin.

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},
A premium product only works when the team knows how to present it, recommend it, and deliver the result consistently. So the starting point is a trial and a conversation — not a large commitment.

items: A professional trial before any wider decision
Professional shade and consultation guidance
Team education on method and application
Approved launch and marketing materials
A direct commercial contact for your account
West Coast fulfillment and trade details, shared once approved

blocks.html: Here’s the current position on fulfillment and trade for your area:
{{us_fulfilment_statement}}
Trade information for {{state}} is available on request: {{trade_link}}

messages.title: Shall I close this for now?
messages.preview: I’ll stop here — reply anytime to reopen the conversation. Nothing expires.
messages.headline: I’ll leave the timing with you.

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},
I’ve sent a couple of notes about a possible Sunless by Jimmy Coco partnership for {{business_name}}, and I don’t want to keep filling your inbox.
I’ll close the conversation here. There’s no deadline and nothing expires — this isn’t that kind of outreach.
If the timing changes, reply anytime and I can pick it up with the current West Coast range, trial route, and trade information.
Thanks for reading — I appreciate your time.

messages.title: Thanks — let’s set up your trial
messages.preview: You’re out of the introduction sequence. A couple of details and we’ll begin.
messages.headline: Thanks — let’s set up your trial.

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},
Thanks for getting back to me. I’ve taken {{business_name}} out of the introduction sequence — you won’t receive any more of those notes.
To set up a professional trial or a consultation, could you confirm a few basics: your business address, your best contact and timing, and who’ll be assessing the result?

items: What you’d like to evaluate — service, retail, or both
Your preferred timing for a trial or call
Any current tanning products you’re comparing against

blocks.html: Once I have that, I’ll walk you through the trial or book a short consultation — whichever you prefer. I won’t confirm stock, delivery, or terms until they’re approved for your area.
Or just reply here and we’ll sort it out by email.

messages.preview: Dispatch confirmation and what to assess during your professional trial.
messages.headline: Your trial is on its way.

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},

blocks.html: When it arrives, try it on a real client and assess the result the way your clients will — in daylight and in photos, not only under treatment-room lighting.

items: How the color develops over the first several hours
Undertone and depth against your client’s skin
How evenly it wears and fades

blocks.html: The professional shade guide walks through shade selection and expected development:
Questions during the trial? Reach me directly at {{support_email}}.

messages.title: How did the color develop?
messages.preview: A quick, honest read on the trial — then a short consultation if it’s a fit.
messages.headline: How did the color develop?

blocks.html: Hi {{first_name}},
Now that you’ve had a chance to use the trial, I’d value your honest read on it.

items: How the color developed, and how believable it looked in daylight
How the application felt for your team
How evenly it wore and faded over the following days

blocks.html: Whatever you found — positive or not — is useful. If it’s a fit, I’m happy to set up a short consultation to talk through range, terms, and a first professional order for your area.
No pressure at all — even a one-line reply helps.
